_about: Raw material for inventing an art direction. style_roll.py combines one entry from each axis. Treat every entry as a starting point to bend toward the topic, never as a finished template. Fonts are Google Fonts (fetch_fonts.py).

media.name: Cyanotype light lab
media.world: Prussian blue sun-print paper; everything drawn in pale cream line art; light itself is a warm glowing thread.
moves: glowing strokes drawn additively
camera rides a pulse of light between stations

media.name: Naturalist's atlas
media.world: Cream plate paper with sepia engravings, roman-numeral plates, hand-tinted accents like a 19th-century field guide.
media.texture: foxing spots, paper fibres, double-rule plate frame
moves: engraved hatching fills
specimen labels with leader lines
plates swap through an opening pupil

media.name: Risograph zine
media.world: Off-white stock printed in two or three spot inks that overprint, misregister and show grain.
media.texture: halftone dots, ink starvation, 2-4 px misregistration
moves: each ink layer prints separately then snaps into register
multiply blending where inks cross

media.name: Drafting vellum
media.world: Translucent drafting sheets with graphite lines, construction marks, dimension arrows and a title block.
media.texture: faint grid, eraser smudges, vellum layers that stack
moves: lines drawn with a ruling pen and compass
sheets slide over each other like overlays

media.name: Swiss poster
media.world: International typographic style: strict grid, huge flush-left type, one hot colour, photographic or geometric figures.
moves: type blocks slide along grid lines
giant numerals count and crop off the frame

media.name: Ukiyo-e woodblock
media.world: Flat woodblock colour fields, bold keyblock outlines, wave and cloud patterns, cartouche titles.
media.texture: wood grain in flat fills, bokashi gradients
moves: colour blocks printed one block at a time
wave patterns that animate as a moving border

media.name: Phosphor oscilloscope
media.world: Black CRT glass, green or amber phosphor traces with bloom and persistence, graticule overlay.
media.texture: scanlines, curvature vignette, trace persistence trails
moves: traces sweep with decaying afterglow
power-off collapse to a dot between scenes

media.name: Stained glass
media.world: Leaded glass panes; ideas become coloured cells separated by dark lead lines, lit from behind.
moves: cells fill with light pane by pane
a sun sweep behind the window

media.name: Cut-paper diorama
media.world: Layered coloured paper cut-outs with soft drop shadows and visible depth, like a shadow box.
media.texture: paper tooth, deckled edges, contact shadows
moves: layers parallax with the camera
pieces fold up from flat like a pop-up book

media.name: Letterpress broadside
media.world: Wood type and metal type on thick cotton paper, ink squash, ornaments and rules.
moves: words stamped in with a press bounce
ornament borders that lock up the page

media.name: Specimen cabinet
media.world: Museum drawers: objects pinned on felt, typed accession labels, brass fittings, glass reflections.
media.texture: felt, glass glare, aged card labels
moves: drawers slide open to reveal each idea
magnifier lens follows a detail

media.name: Transit map
media.world: Ideas are stations, connections are coloured lines at 45 and 90 degrees, interchanges show links.
moves: a train dot travels and the camera follows
new lines branch and route around existing ones

media.name: Sumi ink wash
media.world: Brush ink on rice paper: wet bleeds, dry-brush strokes, a red seal stamp, a lot of empty space.
media.texture: rice paper fibres, ink bleed halos
moves: strokes painted with pressure-varying width
ink drops bloom into the next scene

media.name: Bauhaus geometry
media.world: Primary colours, circles, squares and triangles as the only vocabulary; type set at right angles.
moves: shapes assemble into diagrams and disassemble
rotations snapping to 90 degrees

media.name: Mission control 1969
media.world: NASA-era technical graphics: orbit plots, checklists, grease pencil on plexiglass, teletype.
moves: trajectories plotted with countdown timing
teletype text with carriage return

media.name: Botanical watercolour
media.world: Loose watercolour washes with pencil underdrawing, Latin-style labels, pressed specimen layout.
moves: washes spread wet-in-wet
pencil lines appear before colour

media.name: Chalk slate
media.world: A teacher's slate: dusty chalk, smudged erasures, coloured chalk for emphasis, a ruler and a compass.
media.texture: chalk dust, ghosted erasures of earlier scenes
moves: chalk strokes with grain
the eraser wipes as the transition

media.name: Neon at night
media.world: Bent glass tubes on a dark brick wall; signs flicker on; reflections pool on wet ground.
moves: tubes flicker on segment by segment
hum-like pulsing brightness on emphasis

media.name: Topographic survey
media.world: Contour lines, hillshade, survey marks, grid references and a compass rose; data is terrain.
moves: contours grow outward from peaks
camera flies over terrain like a drone

media.name: Halftone newspaper
media.world: Broadsheet columns, halftone photo dots, headlines and pull quotes, newsprint grey.
media.texture: newsprint fibres, coarse halftone, slight ink rub
moves: headlines drop in as the press rolls
zoom into halftone dots that become the next scene

media.name: Gouache picture book
media.world: Opaque gouache shapes, chunky shapes and warm light, a quiet storybook mood, but grown-up information.
media.texture: dry-brush edges, paper texture, small paint flecks
moves: page turns with curl and shadow
characters or objects walk the idea across the spread

media.name: Linocut
media.world: Carved relief print: chunky white gouge marks in black, one bold accent colour, rough edges.
moves: the image is carved away mark by mark
roller sweeps ink across as the cut

media.name: Ligne claire comic
media.world: Clean even outlines, flat colours, panels and gutters, caption boxes; Hergé-like clarity.
moves: camera moves panel to panel
speech or caption boxes pop with a hand-drawn tail

media.name: Isometric toy world
media.world: A tiny isometric diorama; ideas are buildings, machines and moving parts on a turntable.
moves: blocks drop in and stack with a bounce
the world rotates 90 degrees between scenes

media.name: Tufte journal figure
media.world: Austere scientific figures: sparklines, small multiples, direct labels, margin notes, lots of white.
moves: data drawn point by point
margin notes slide in with thin leaders

media.name: Islamic geometric tiling
media.world: Star-and-rosette tessellations built with compass and straightedge; ideas live in the cells.
moves: construction circles appear before the pattern
tiling spreads outward by symmetry

media.name: Light table film strip
media.world: Negatives and slides on a glowing light table, loupe, grease pencil marks, sprocket holes.
moves: strip advances frame by frame
loupe magnifies a frame into full screen

media.name: Embroidery sampler
media.world: Cross-stitch and running stitch on linen: diagrams become thread, borders are stitched alphabets.
moves: stitches appear along a path
hoop rotates to frame each scene

media.name: Art Deco gilt
media.world: Black lacquer and gold leaf, sunbursts, stepped frames and stylised geometric figures.
moves: sunburst rays fan open
stepped frames telescope inward

media.name: Blueprint machine
media.world: White linework on blueprint blue: exploded views, section cuts, part numbers and callouts.
moves: parts explode apart and reassemble
section plane slices through an object

transitions: iris or pupil opening from the centre
page turn with curl and shadow
ink bleed: a drop spreads and becomes the next scene
wipe along a line that is being drawn
infinite zoom: dive into a detail that becomes the next scene
camera travels along a route to the next station
CRT collapse to a dot and back on
press stamp: the next sheet is printed on top
sheet slides in from a stack, with a contact shadow
light leak flare that washes to the next scene
match cut: a shape in one scene becomes a shape in the next
focus pull: blur out, blur in
the drawing un-draws in reverse, then the next draws
camera: fixed plates: each scene is a still composition that animates inside itself
one continuous world: all scenes live on one huge canvas and the camera flies between them
vertical scroll: a long scroll or ticker tape moving upward
turntable: the subject rotates and the camera orbits
dolly into details: every scene ends by pushing into the element that starts the next
map pan: the camera follows a route, scale changes with altitude
split screen: two panes argue, merge or swap
through_lines: a single thread, wire or beam that runs through every scene
a numbered plate or exhibit system with captions
a recurring object that changes role per scene
a ledger or counter that keeps running totals
a journey map whose next stop each scene adds
a lab notebook whose pages fill up
a clock or timeline ribbon along the edge
a growing diagram that becomes the summary at the end
a colour code that is introduced once and kept strictly
a recurring frame shape (circle, arch, window) that every scene uses
energy: calm and spacious: slow eases, long holds, few elements
brisk and editorial: snappy eases, type-led, rhythmic cuts
playful and tactile: bounces, physical props, squash and stretch
precise and technical: linear sweeps, measured reveals, grids
warm and story-like: soft light, gentle parallax, character-driven
layout: rule of thirds with one dominant element
margin-note layout: main figure plus annotated margin
full-bleed illustration with small type in a corner block
diagonal composition with movement left to right
